recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. The current build already satisfies the accepted FHIR-13985 clarification, and additional wording would be redundant rather than corrective.
issue_request: FHIR-13985 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification for FHIR-core Search, asking how to handle a chained query such as AllergyIntolerance?patient.identifier=http://mysys|100 when no Patient has that identifier. The resolution was to add more words to the search error safety guidance for parameters that have no matching values.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn r13431, preserved as git commit f341085fbec8cabb1d80347a17544919dd816297, which added a patient.identifier no-match example and explanatory text to source/search.html. Later search-page rewrites and cleanup changed formatting and wording but preserved the substance.
additional_context: The linked Zulip #implementers > Search issues thread records the exact question and rationale: ordinary no-match searches return an empty set, while a server may still choose an error in narrow recognized-identifier cases. The current Search page is in build scope through publish.ini, and bounded Jira/Confluence/community searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/search.html already says an empty search result is not an error, that logical no-match conditions SHOULD be processed by returning an empty search set, and that the search set may include an OperationOutcome warning; it also includes the patient.identifier no-MRN example and warning-bundle link.
